summary: Revised implementation plan incorporating refined AR activation architecture: treating 'load' as the primary readiness gate (with 'model-visibility' for UX refinement only), immediate gesture activation when cached/preloaded, switching to reveal='auto', viewport-registered non-zero hidden launcher sizing, differentiated error classification (ar-unsupported, model-load-error, network-error, cancellation), button loading guard with spinner, and full asset path verification.
